caption: Mains normally charges a 48 V battery on the DC bus; the inverter feeds the load. The dashed static bypass carries the load straight from mains if the inverter trips or is overloaded. Servicing uses a separate maintenance bypass that isolates the whole UPS.

spec.title: On-line UPS
spec.aria: Mains feeds a rectifier that holds a DC bus with a battery; an inverter feeds the load, and a static bypass can join the load straight to the mains.
